t.zh: 检查台能判断答案，却说不出图里的数从哪里来，也读不了、改不了、算不了一个像素。这一章给它装上相机与图像工作台：先弄清一张图怎样存成数，再搭相机模型和处理图像的电路。
t.en: The station could judge answers but could not say where an image's numbers come from, nor read, change or compute a single pixel. This chapter gives it a camera and image workbench: first how an image is stored as numbers, then camera models and circuits that process images.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：相机拍下的这张小图，存进计算机是什么样子？画面旁边是一张空格子，行数和列数由你填出的样子决定。灰度图里每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>是一个数：0 是黑，1 是白，中间是不同深浅的灰。照着画面填，形状和每个数都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: what does this small picture from the camera look like once it is stored in the computer? Beside the picture is an empty grid whose rows and columns are whatever you fill in. In a grey image each <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> is one number: 0 is black, 1 is white, and the numbers between are shades of grey. Fill it from the picture; it is right when the shape and every number are.

after.zh: 灰度图存成 高 × 宽 的<wiki-ref to="image-array"></wiki-ref>，彩色图再多一维通道：高 × 宽 × 3。像素只说多亮，不说多远。
after.en: A grey image is stored as a height × width <wiki-ref to="image-array"></wiki-ref>, a colour image with one more axis for channels: height × width × 3. A pixel says how bright, not how far.

brief.zh: 照着画面，把这张 3 像素宽、2 像素高的灰度图存成一格格的数。
brief.en: Following the picture, store this grey image, 3 pixels wide and 2 high, as cells of numbers.

hint.zh: 画面里只有三种颜色：黑、中灰、白。
hint.en: The picture holds only three shades: black, mid grey and white.

why.zh: 这是按 宽 × 高 抄的：画面的第一行像素抄成了格子的第一列。数组先写高、再写宽，格子的第 y 行就是画面的第 y 行。
why.en: This is copied as width × height: the picture's first row went into the grid's first column. An array lists height first, then width; row y of the grid is row y of the picture.

brief.zh: 再存一张 2 像素宽、3 像素高的灰度图。
brief.en: Now store a grey image 2 pixels wide and 3 high.

hint.zh: 画面里的一行像素，存成格子里的哪一行？
hint.en: Which row of the grid does a row of pixels in the picture go to?

why.zh: 这张图 2 像素宽、3 像素高，抄出来却是 2 行 3 列：行和列对调了，每一行要是画面里的一行像素。
why.en: The image is 2 pixels wide and 3 high, but this copy has 2 rows of 3: rows and columns are swapped, and each row must be one row of the picture's pixels.

t.zh: 彩色图多一维<wiki-ref to="channel"></wiki-ref>：每个像素存三个数 (R, G, B)，说红、绿、蓝各有多亮，各在 0 到 1 之间。
t.en: A colour image has one more axis, the <wiki-ref to="channel"></wiki-ref>: each pixel stores three numbers (R, G, B), how bright its red, green and blue are, each from 0 to 1.

brief.zh: 把第二行正中间那个像素改成纯蓝，别的格子不动。
brief.en: Turn the middle pixel of the second row pure blue, leaving every other cell as it is.

hint.zh: 纯蓝：蓝色最亮，红和绿一点也没有。
hint.en: Pure blue: the blue at its brightest, no red and no green at all.

why.zh: 只把第二行正中间那个像素的蓝色调到 1，得到 (1, 1, 1)，那是白色：纯蓝还要红和绿都是 0。
why.en: Raising only the blue number of the middle pixel in the second row gives (1, 1, 1), which is white: pure blue also needs its red and green at 0.
